Definition: from G4012 and G4486; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend off.
BiblicalUsage: Perirrhegnymi means to tear all around, to rend off completely. The multitude rose up against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates rent off their clothes and commanded them to be beaten.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the tearing of clothes was the tearing of dignity: the magistrates stripped them before the crowd, and God clothed them with honour.
RelatedEvents: Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
